messages:
Maria Nguyen: Postmortem follow-up: consolidate runbook/playbook changes for the cache-eviction recurring pattern. Need triage commands, clear escalation path, rollback decision points, and a staging test plan. Who takes what?

Sam Patel: I will own the runbook content and triage steps. Will add example commands and a quick checklist. Target Tue COB.

Alex Chen: Ill handle escalation flow and paging thresholds, plus a short decision tree for rollback vs fallback. Target Mon EOD.

Tess SRE: Please include the exact kubectl and PromQL snippets we used. Also add a short validation checklist for staging.

OpsBot: Incident snapshot: 2026-03-22 03:12Z - KV cache thrash -> worker spinups -> evictions -> latency spike. Artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/incidents/2026-03-22/cache-thrash

Sam Patel: Key commands to capture:
```
# list cache pods and describe
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=kv-cache -o wide
kubectl -n inference describe pod kv-cache-0
# eviction metric query
curl -s 'http://prometheus.internal/api/v1/query?query=cache_evictions_total'
# rotate cache on a replica
kubectl -n inference exec kv-cache-0 -- /bin/sh -c 'mv /data/cache /data/cache.bak && kill 1'
```

Jordan Riley: I'll write a smoke test that simulates a TTL storm and validates that eviction backoff prevents cascade. Will push to staging pipeline. Target next Fri.

Maria Nguyen: Owners summary: Sam (runbook), Alex (escalation/paging), Jordan (smoke tests), Tess (validation). Deadlines: Alex Mon EOD, Sam Tue COB, Jordan Fri, Tess validate within 48h of PR merge. @Oncall Bot confirm no overlap with dedicated runbooks.

Oncall Bot: @oncall Ack - no current dedicated-runbook conflicts. Recommend canary publish to staging first.

Sam Patel: Opened runbook PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runbooks/pulls/1302 - includes steps, commands, and checklist. Tagging with 'postmortem-cache-eviction'.

Tess SRE: Quick review: add PromQL for kv_cache_inflight and a step to check pod OOM/kubelet evictions. Also suggest a short note on when to reduce batch size.

Alex Chen: Added a rollback bullet: (1) route to smaller-serving variant, (2) reduce batch sizes, (3) if traffic safe, roll back recent routing change. I'll add thresholds.

Maria Nguyen: I'll update the postmortem tracker with owners and dates and schedule a 30m tabletop to exercise the new playbook. Booking for Thu 09:30 PT.

Jordan Riley: Tabletop booked. Will include a short synthetic TTL storm run in staging.

Sam Patel: Thanks all, will address Tess's review items and merge once staging smoke passes.
